dr_volunteer.text: Welcome to the old station! The County Donegal Railways ran on narrow gauge, three feet between the rails, over a hundred miles of it, up glens and over bogs.
They were famous for their little railcars, buzzing up the lines like bees with timetables. The last trains ran at the end of 1959. We're restoring what we can.

dr_trainspotter.text: A three-foot gauge! You could step across it! I have stepped across it. Many times. It never gets old.
